title: Unlocking the secrets of the midplane gas and dust distribution in the young hybrid disc HD 141569
question: What are the mass and spatial structure of the gas and dust in the midplane of the hybrid disc HD 141569, and how does it compare with debris, hybrid and protoplanetary discs?

what.value: 12CO(3-2) data, PA=-9 deg and inclination=55 deg

evidence.quote: we adopt the values of the $^{12}$CO disc, PA=-9$^{\circ}$ and inclination=55$^{\circ}$ (cite: White2016ALMADISK)

what.value: dust opacity 1.15 cm2/g for mm grains

evidence.quote: an opacity, $\kappa_\nu$, corresponding to mm size grains of 1.15 cm$^{2}$g$^{-1}$ (cite: Draine2006OnDisks)

what.value: VLA flux of 54 μJy used for free-free extrapolation

evidence.quote: we extrapolate from VLA flux of 54 $\mu$Jy (cite: MacGregor2016CONSTRAINTSDISKS)
assume ISM abundances of $^{12}$CO/$^{13}$CO = 77 and $^{12}$CO/H$_2$=10$^{-4}$ (cite: Wilson1994AbundancesMedium)

recipe.goal: Calibrate and image continuum and CO lines
recipe.method: ALMA pipeline calibration, uv continuum subtraction, clean with natural weighting
Azimuthal averaging in radial bins after deprojection with 12CO disc PA and inclination; noise from emission-free regions

assumptions: T=20 K, kappa=1.15 cm2/g, d=111 pc, all emission thermal

recipe.method: Ratio of 12CO(2-1) (scaled from 3-2 with RADEX ratio 1.08) to 13CO(2-1)
assumptions: same excitation temperature; optical depth ratio 77

recipe.goal: Gas mass from 13CO and C18O limit
recipe.method: Optically thin line-flux mass formula with ISM abundances

evidence.quote: a ring of millimetre emission at 220$\pm$10 au
The minimum dust mass of the ring is 0.13$\pm$0.02 M$_{\oplus}$
a minimum of 1.2$\pm$0.2 M$_{\oplus}$ of dust
an unresolved point source of 1.7 mJy is detected
yielding a total gas mass estimate of 1.4$\times$10$^{-4}$ M$_\odot$

not_stated_but_needed: Clean threshold, mask, image size and cell size
Velocity range and integration limits for 13CO moment map
Exact 13CO integrated flux and 12CO(3-2) data processing
Excitation/partition treatment used in gas mass formula
